result_text:
Cancelled purchase orders are now left out of the per-sales-rep count. The related tests pass.

**What changed**

- `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/PurchaseOrderStore.java`, `countPerSalesRep`: the count query now excludes `CANCELLED` purchase orders, using the same `NOT_CANCELLED` condition the quarter and latest-PO reports use. I also added a line to its Javadoc saying so.
- Same file, the comment on `listForCountry`: it said cancelled orders are included "as for the counts per sales rep and per country". It now says only "as for the count per country", since the per-rep count no longer includes them.
- `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`: added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which reproduces your example (Anna 2, Bob 1). I gave the test helper an optional status parameter to build it.

**Verification:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` (4 tests), `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest` (3) and `LatestPurchaseOrdersTest` (4) all pass offline, with 0 failures. I did not run the full suite.

**Not changed:** the per-country purchase order count (`countPerCountry`) also still includes cancelled orders. It is outside this report, so I left it alone, but it has the same problem if you want it fixed too. Nothing is committed.
